jobs.occupation: Senior Operational Technology (OT) Security Officer, flere lokationer | Ørsted
jobs.description:
Imagine a future where you'll protect the ability to supply electricity and heat to the end user and make sure that our critical OT systems are protected against hackers

We offer a workplace culture where you’ll be working from the office every work day.

Join us in this role where you’ll be working as a Senior Operational Technology (OT) Security Officer to strengthen the security, resilience, and compliance of Ørsted Bioenergy. In this role, you will act as a trusted security lead across OT, IT, engineering, and operations, helping protect critical systems while enabling safe, reliable, and efficient operations. Further more we are partnering with operations, engineering, maintenance, IT, and third-party vendors to ensure security controls are practical, risk-based, and compatible with operational safety and availability – and we “translate” technical cyber risk into clear business, safety, and operational impact requirements. We operate in complex, multi-site, international, or safety-critical operational environments.

**Welcome to Bioenergy

**You’ll be part of OT Security where you, together with your colleagues, will be working on Ørsted Danish powerplant. Our task is to protect the powerplants ability to produce electricity and heat against hacker attacks. So you need to understand Danish, when you’re out on the powerplants. We are a small team of 4 persons located in Jutland (Jylland) who works together and strive in helping each other in our daily tasks. As a team, we have an open and direct commutation where we discuss ideas strategy and ideas to develop and mature our solutions, so they are robust and they deal with the reality we face.

You’ll play an important role in:

• leading the development and continuous improvement of OT security governance, policies, standards, and procedures

• assessing, managing, and reducing cyber risk across OT environments, including industrial control systems, SCADA, PLCs, IIoT, and related networks

• defining and supporting secure OT architecture, including network segmentation, secure remote access, asset visibility, access control, logging, monitoring, and vulnerability management

• conducting OT security risk assessments, gap analyses, and maturity reviews aligned with recognised frameworks e.g. Danish legislation “Lov om styrket Beredskab i Energisektoren”, IEC 62443, ISO 27001 and relevant regulatory requirements

• partnering with operations, engineering, maintenance, IT, and third-party vendors to ensure security controls are practical, risk-based, and compatible with operational safety and availability requirements

• driving OT security awareness and training for technical and operational teams.

To succeed in the role, you:

• hold a relevant degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Cyber Security, Information Technology, Automation, or equivalent practical experience

• understand and know how to operate in ICS systems and possess understanding of 24/7 production environment

• are familiar with IT networks like, Purdue model, firewall, data diodes etc.

• hold knowledge about EIC 62433, ISO 27001 and "Lov om styrket Beredskab i Energisektoren" as we operate according to this legislation

• are a good team player and at the same are strong on being responsible of incl. conducting your own tasks – you need to be fluent in both Danish and English language as well due to nature our stake holder landscape

• are flexible - both in terms of taking on tasks outside your comfortzone, being curious in learning new areas and assist your team in whatever tasks are needed.

Some travel within Denmark to the different sites must be expected in the this role.

Maybe you’ve read the above and can see you have some transferable skills, even though they don’t quite match all the points. If you think you can bring something to the team, we still encourage you to apply.

**Shape the future with us

**Send your application and CV to us as soon as possible. We’ll be conducting interviews on a continuous basis and reserve the right to take down the advert when we’ve found the right candidate.

As an applicant or employee, you may request reasonable work and position accommodation or adjustments via accommodation@orsted.com.

Please note that for your application to be taken into consideration, you must submit your application via our online career pages and answer the screening questions relevant for your country. We don't take applications or inquiries from external recruiters or agencies into account for this position.

Position salary range: For this position, the expected base pay range is kr55,040.00- kr82,560.00 for the advertised location. The offered base salary will be determined within this range based on relevant skills, experience, and expected role fulfilment within the stated pay range to ensure a fair and competitive offer. Where applicable, you may also be eligible for variable payment and a comprehensive benefits package.

**Our benefits package:

**For this position, employees who meet eligibility requirements have access to: employer‑paid pension (11 % contribution), full insurance coverage (accident, life, critical illness, and health insurance); five weeks of paid holiday plus 10 additional paid days off per holiday year; a 3 % holiday allowance; access to Ørsted Life & Fitness Vitality including fitness classes, physiotherapy, massage, and well-being programmes; a multimedia package (mobile phone, PC, and internet); staff club membership with sport and cultural activities; and access to the company canteen (monthly lunch scheme or daily tickets).

**Pre-employment background check:

**This position requires a background check as part of the hiring process and the offer is dependent on the outcome of this check. You will receive more information during the recruitment process. Background checks are conducted by an external provider in accordance with local legal requirements.

Do you want to be at the forefront of protecting our society against cyber threats? We are looking for a Key account manager to our Commercial organization.

About Truesec – A Leading Cybersecurity Company

Since 2005, Truesec has been a native cybersecurity company, driven by one single purpose: Creating safety and sustainability in a digital world by preventing cyber breach and minimizing impact.

Over the years, we’ve earned the trust of organizations worldwide and gained a strong reputation internationally. Our team consists of dedicated specialists covering the entire spectrum of cybersecurity – with capabilities in Predict, Prevent, Protect, Respond, and Recover.

Today, we employ around 400 employees – and as cybercrime grows, we need to grow. To support that goal, we are now looking for a Key Account Manager who wants to make a difference.

The Role

At Truesec Denmark, we're on the lookout for an experienced Key Account Manager to drive our continued growth by winning new business and nurturing strong relationships with our great customers. As one of the primary points of contact, you will ensure our customers remain satisfied while we drive our business forward with high professionalism. You will cover customers in all of Denmark however the majority of your key accounts will be in Jutland. You will also:

• Create new business: Take the initiative and discover new opportunities to expand our customer portfolio. You will have freedom to set goals and initiatives that makes the Danish team perform even better than today.

• Build & retain relationships: Develop and maintain strong bonds with our customers, ensuring their needs are consistently met.

• Understand customer & market needs: Gain deep insights into our customers’ business goals and cybersecurity requirements in general.

• Drive growth: Identify chances to expand existing partnerships through upselling and cross-selling.

• Collaborate internally: Work closely with our teams to ensure we deliver solutions that exceed customer expectations.

• Monitor and report: Keep an eye on customer satisfaction, account performance, and market trends, and share your insights with the team.

• Stay informed: Keep up with the latest industry trends, emerging threats, and competitive developments to always offer the best advice.

Your Potential Background

To succeed in this role, we believe that you

• Bring extensive experience from the cybersecurity industry.

• Have a proven success as a Key Account Manager or in a similar client-facing role, ideally within the cybersecurity sector.

• Demonstrate exceptional communication and interpersonal skills, fostering strong connections with clients and stakeholders.

• Possess a proactive, results-oriented attitude and thrives in dynamic, fast-paced environments.

• Excel in organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities simultaneously.

• Have a track record of building and maintaining long-term, trusted client relationships.

• Tackles challenges with a solution-driven mindset and remains composed under pressure.

• Are proficient in CRM tools (preferably Hubspot) and skilled in using the Microsoft Office Suite.

• Exhibit business-level fluency in reading, writing, and speaking both Danish and English.

Due to the sensitivity in our assignments, we require Danish or Swedish citizenship or citizenship in an EU country.

Join Our Mission Toward a Safe Digital Future

If you truly want to make a difference and make our world a little bit safer, this is the place for you. At Truesec, you'll get to be at the forefront of fighting cybercrime instead of reading about it in the news. This is your chance to be part of an exciting journey in a leading cybersecurity company - and learn from some of the best in their field.

So, are you ready to team up with the most dedicated team of experts and be part of a meaningful mission? Then we are excited to get to know you!

jobs.occupation: Tax Professional, Customer Handling, Securities Tax Services (Copenhagen)
jobs.description:
**Job Description

**Are you customer-focused, structured and motivated by working in an operational area where quality, documentation and service delivery are key? Do you enjoy supporting customers and advisers, coordinating with internal stakeholders and ensuring that processes run efficiently from start to finish?

We are looking for a detail-oriented colleague to join our Customer Handling Team/Tax Services team in Copenhagen. The team serves as a primary point of contact for advisers and customers and plays an important role in onboarding, documentation management, customer support and service delivery related to securities tax services.

On clients’ behalf, Danske Bank applies for a reduction in foreign tax on returns from securities held in customers’ custody accounts. This includes relief of foreign dividend and interest tax, either at source or through tax reclaim processes. The service is complementary to Danske Bank’s custody service and is particularly relevant for clients earning income on foreign financial instruments, where a tax reduction may be available under applicable double taxation agreements.

**About Securities Tax Services

**Securities Tax Services is part of Danske Bank’s tax area and is responsible for handling services related to withholding tax on securities. The area consists of several teams located in Denmark and Lithuania, working closely together across locations, functions and customer segments.

You will join a team of skilled specialists who support corporate, institutional and other customer segments. We value collaboration, curiosity, continuous learning and a strong focus on delivering high-quality service in a well-controlled environment.

**Your role

**As a team member in Customer Handling, you will support customers and advisers with inquiries, documentation and service-related matters. You will help ensure that customer agreements, onboarding, offboarding and service changes are handled correctly and efficiently.

Your main responsibilities will include:

• Acting as a first point of contact for customer and adviser inquiries

• Handling customer onboarding and offboarding activities

• Ensuring customer agreements and service documentation are sent, received and registered correctly

• Collecting, reviewing and maintaining required customer documentation

• Supporting changes to customer preferences and service setups

• Following up with customers and advisers on outstanding documentation and requests

• Coordinating with internal stakeholders to ensure efficient service delivery

• Participating in client meetings and supporting customer relationship management

• Maintaining and updating information in internal systems

• Supporting controls to ensure accurate and compliant processing

• Contributing to continuous improvement of customer processes and service quality

The role combines recurring operational tasks with customer interaction and collaboration across teams. You will get exposure to securities services, withholding tax processes, custody-related services and post-trade operations.

**About You

**We are looking for a structured and service-minded colleague who enjoys working with customers, documentation and operational processes. You take ownership of tasks, communicate clearly and can manage several activities while maintaining attention to detail.

We imagine that you:

• Have experience from customer service, client support, operations, financial services or a similar area

• Have a customer-centric mindset and strong communication skills

• Are comfortable working with documentation, regulations and operational processes

• Can manage multiple tasks while maintaining high accuracy

• Collaborate well with colleagues and stakeholders across teams and locations

• Are proactive, curious and willing to learn in a complex environment

• Have strong English skills, both written and spoken

Experience from Asset Services, post-trade operations, custody services or withholding tax is considered an advantage.

**What We Offer You

**You will join a supportive team environment where you can develop your expertise through varied work and mentorship opportunities. We operate a hybrid working model with 3 to 4 days per week in the office to promote collaboration and knowledge sharing. Your career will progress through exposure to diverse tax challenges and continuous learning opportunities.

**Are you ready for the next step?

**We would be delighted to hear from you if this opportunity aligns with your career aspirations. Please reach out to our hiring manager Nicolai William Schou Hansen at nicoh@danskebank.dk for any questions about the role. We look forward to hearing from you!

We review applications on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

**Founders Associate (Part-Time, min. 24 h/week)

Company: Levitate Technology ApS

Location: Copenhagen/Herlev

Start: As soon as possible

****About Us

**Levitate Technology is a fast-growing Danish startup that makes sports and everyday prosthetics for amputees. Our mission is to give amputees better lives through innovative, affordable products. We're growing internationally, and we're looking for a Founders Associate to work closely with our Founder & CEO and keep the company running smoothly.

**The Role

**Your job is to keep things moving. You'll be the link between management, our team, and a wide range of external partners. You will take part in Management meetings, own key business processes and administer the systems the company runs on. You'll also support the CEO on strategic topics that shape where Levitate goes next. The role is broad and varied, with real responsibility from day one.

**What You'll Be Part Of

**

• Company building: helping build the processes and structures that support Levitate's growth.

• Board meetings: helping prepare board materials and following decisions through, with a close view of strategic decision-making.

• Funding and investor relations: supporting funding rounds and investor communication.

**Responsibilities

**

• Stakeholder communication: Be the main point of contact for a wide range of internal and external stakeholders. This includes our external finance team, our bank, our insurance provider, and other partners.

• Strategic projects: Support the CEO on strategic initiatives. This means preparing analyses, following up on company KPIs, and turning information into clear input for management and board decisions.

• Systems administration: Act as admin for our company tools, including Shopify, Google Workspace, Slack, Claude and the rest of our stack. You'll manage users, access and permissions, and keep things organised.

• HR and people operations: Support hiring, payroll, onboarding and offboarding, and day-to-day people operations. You'll work closely with management and external partners.

• Meeting support: Organise and prepare internal and board meetings. This covers agendas, slides, minutes and follow-ups.

• Documentation: Prepare documents, reports and presentations.

• Confidentiality: Handle sensitive company, financial and employee information with discretion.

**Who You Are

**

• Enrolled in a relevant degree with at least one year of studies remaining, preferably a master's programme at Copenhagen Business School.

• Relevant experience from a similar role, a startup, or a management support function.

• Excellent written and spoken English.

• Structured and reliable, with strong attention to detail.

• Analytical, with an interest in strategy and how a company grows.

• Comfortable juggling many topics and stakeholders at once, and able to take ownership without being told every step.

• Confident with digital tools and quick to learn new systems.

**Practical Information

**

• Start date: As soon as possible.

• Hours: minimum of 24 hours per week, flexible around your studies.

• Location: Our office in Herlev, with the option to work from home. You'll be at the office at least 3 days a week.

**What We Offer

**

• A competitive part-time salary.

• Direct collaboration with the Founder & CEO, with insight into strategy, board work and fundraising.

• Real responsibility and a broad view across finance, HR, operations and systems.

• A mission-driven, international team.

• Flexibility to balance work with your studies.

**How To Apply

**Apply through The Hub with your CV and a short motivation statement explaining why this role suits you. We review applications on a rolling basis.

Levitate Technology ApS is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and are committed to an inclusive workplace.

**SOUNDBOKS is an innovative tech company and aspiring lifestyle brand. You may have seen us at a music festival, street party, or your friend’s celebration (think: private events combining festival-grade sound with beat-enhancing lights) where special moments are turned into memories. We create the loudest, most durable, and arguably coolest Bluetooth speakers and audio reactive lights on the market.

At SOUNDBOKS, trust and community go hand in hand. People are encouraged to take ownership of their work while knowing they have the support of the team behind them. Voices are heard, ideas are welcomed, and collaboration is what pushes us forward.

This is more than a job - it’s a community where people care about each other, celebrate together, and share the energy of creating something meaningful. Life at SOUNDBOKS is bold, fast, and full of passion - for the product, for the mission, and for showing up as your true self. With 70 team members, this is a place where you can do your best work and truly belong.

ROLE AUDIO ENGINEER

TEAM PRODUCT DEVELOPMENT

HOURS FULL TIME

LOCATION COPENHAGEN, DENMARK

START DATE OCTOBER 2026 or ASAP

The Product Development team at SOUNDBOKS is the group responsible for the exciting product journey, taking every step of the development process toward and into mass production. In it’s heartbeat you’ll find collaborative and self-driven team members with a large cross-discipline understanding tied to ownership. They are there to make a difference - for the products, the team and the SOUNDBOKS customers as a whole.

As our Audio Engineer, you'll explore new ways to improve the audio experience across SOUNDBOKS products by combining signal processing, system simulation, and engineering insight. Working closely with the Acoustics, Hardware, and Firmware teams, you'll help shape the technologies behind our next generation of speakers.

Okay, let’s make things a little more concrete. Here’s what we expect your daily life to look like:

**Audio System Development

**

• Develop audio concepts and proof-of-concepts at a system level.

• Explore new approaches to improve audio performance across products.

• Collaborate with the Acoustics, Hardware, and Firmware teams during concept development.

**Signal Processing & Simulation

**

• Perform advanced signal processing simulations with a focus on sound pressure level (SPL), sound quality, and system efficiency.

• Simulate the interaction between acoustics, amplifiers, electronics, and battery performance.

• Evaluate and develop signal processing algorithms to improve overall product audio performance.

**System Performance & Collaboration

**

• Work closely across the entire Product Development team in order to evolve and improve the audio performance across our future product portfolio.

• Apply signal processing methodologies to improve sound pressure, sound quality, and battery performance.

**Job Requirements

****In order to become a success in this role, we believe that your profile should be aligned with the bullets listed below. However, we acknowledge that success can take many forms, so please do apply even if you don’t tick all the boxes.

**

• You hold a BSc or higher in Audio Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Acoustics, or a related engineering field.

• You've designed and simulated audio systems, ideally loudspeakers, and know your way around signal processing for audio.

• You're comfortable using simulations and measurements to test ideas, challenge assumptions, and make better engineering decisions.

• It’ll be considered a plus if you have experience working with loudspeaker design, transducers, enclosure design, or audio electronics.

• You get excited by solving difficult audio problems and finding smarter ways to improve performance.

• You're naturally curious, love experimenting, and enjoy digging into the details until things sound and work better.

• You take ownership of your work and enjoy bouncing ideas around with people who know more than you in their field.

• You're drawn to what SOUNDBOKS is building and are excited to be a part of the journey!

Intrigued? At SOUNDBOKS you’ll find yourself a part of a community. We realize that growth is a process and we don’t expect you to go through it alone. Actually, we guarantee that you won’t have to. We work together in order to work smarter, we inspire each other to be better, and we never forget that every member of the team is responsible for our success.

So, if you’re tired of all of the noise in the job market, we’d love to hear from you. This may be the coolest job you ever have."

**Why join us?

**Muuto is rooted in the Scandinavian design tradition characterized by enduring aesthetics, functionality, craftsmanship and an honest expression. By expanding this heritage with forward-looking materials, techniques and bold creative thinking, our ambition is to deliver new perspectives on Scandinavian design.

We are looking for a commercially minded and analytical Category Manager to strengthen our global supplier network, drive category performance, and support the continued growth of our business.

As Category Manager, you will play a key role in developing and managing supplier relationships, improving operational performance, and ensuring that our supply chain remains scalable, resilient, and aligned with Muuto’s ambitious growth plans.

**Key Responsibilities

**You will be responsible for a portfolio of suppliers and product categories, working closely with Product Development, Sustainability, and Commercial teams.

Your key responsibilities will include:

• Developing and executing category strategies aligned with business objectives

• Managing supplier relationships, negotiations, and performance reviews

• Driving continuous improvements in lead time, delivery performance, quality, and cost

• Identifying and implementing sourcing opportunities and risk mitigation plans

• Leading supplier development initiatives and supporting dual sourcing strategies

• Monitoring KPIs and using data-driven insights to improve category performance

• Supporting new product introductions from design to market launch

• Collaborating with cross-functional stakeholders to optimize supply chain performance

• Ensuring supplier compliance with Muuto standards, sustainability requirements, and business processes

• Driving transparency and reporting across supplier and category performance

**WHO ARE YOU?

**We imagine that you have:

• A bachelor’s or master’s degree in Supply Chain, Engineering, Business, Procurement, or a related field

• 5+ years of experience within Category Management, Procurement, Strategic Sourcing, or Supply Chain

• Strong negotiation and stakeholder management skills

• Experience managing international suppliers and complex supply chains

• Strong analytical capabilities and experience working with KPIs and performance management

• Commercial understanding combined with a collaborative and relationship-focused approach

• The ability to balance strategic thinking with hands-on execution

• Excellent communication skills in English

• Experience from furniture, design, consumer goods, or manufacturing industries will be considered an advantage.

**WE OFFER

**At Muuto, you become part of an international design company where creativity, collaboration, and entrepreneurship are part of everyday life.

You will get:

• A key role in shaping supplier and category strategies

• Exposure to a global supplier network

• Close collaboration with design, product development, and commercial teams

• Opportunities for professional and personal development

• A dynamic, informal, and ambitious work environment

• The chance to contribute to one of the strongest design brands in the Scandinavian industry

You will report to the Supply Chain Manager, and the position is expected to start as soon as possible.

To learn more about Muuto, our products, and our designers, please visit Muuto.com.

If you are interested, please upload your CV and application via the link as soon as possible.

**Who We Hire?

**At Muuto, our mission is to deliver new perspectives on Scandinavian design. We are an international team of ambitious and passionate people - all driven by the desire to expand on the Scandinavian design tradition with a forward-looking, creative and honest approach. We are looking for qualified applicants representing a wide range of backgrounds and abilities who share this same mindset. Individuals who wish to actively contribute and bring their opinion to the table. Individuals who would like to bring a wealth of new perspectives to our company.

That is why we are always keen to hear from talented people who wish to join our company - regardless of gender identity, age, sexual orientation, ethnicity, racial identity, religious belief and disability status. We are committed to equal opportunity employment.

To learn more about Muuto, our products and designers, please visit www.muuto.com

jobs.occupation: HSO International - Microsoft D365 Project Manager
jobs.description:
HSO International – Project Manager

Position: Project Manager

Department: Program Services

Visa Sponsorship: You must have legal working rights in your country of residence within the EMEA region. Sponsorship and relocation only available within the Netherlands

Type of work: Remote or Hybrid, depending on location

International travel is required depending on program needs. **Minimun 35% travelling

****About The Role

**The Project Manager at HSO is accountable for the successful delivery of a defined project or major workstream within a broader transformation program. This role owns delivery outcomes within clear boundaries: scope, schedule, quality, readiness, and customer adoption for their project.

In this role, your primary focus is on driving execution excellence. You spend most of your time on detailed planning, sequencing, dependency management, readiness control (testing, data, cutover), issue resolution, and day-to-day delivery leadership. You optimize outcomes within given constraints and ensure that delivery reality is visible early.

If you want a role where you own the execution layer of large or complex global programs and make a direct impact on delivery success, this is it.

**Leading Microsoft Partner

**HSO belongs to the elite Microsoft Dynamics Inner Circle for 21 years, within the top 1% of all Microsoft partners worldwide. With over 2,800 professionals and a worldwide presence, we deliver successful implementations across industries globally.

**HSO International

**At HSO International, you’ll join a diverse team of 300+ colleagues from 50+ nationalities, working on cross-border projects that make a global impact.

Learn more about Life at HSO International: https://www.hso.com/en/campaigns/life-at-hso-international/

**Key Responsibilities

**

• Own day-to-day delivery of assigned projects or complex program workstreams, ensuring scope, plan, dependencies, and customer readiness remain aligned

• Participate in pre-sales and mobilization by shaping delivery plans, budgets, governance models, and risk assumptions that are executable in practice

• Contribute to and co-author Statements of Work (SOW), with specific accountability for assumptions, risks, delivery economics, team structures, phase entry/exit criteria, and change control

• Build and maintain integrated delivery plans that align architecture, build, testing, integrations, and customer activities

• Coordinate cross-functional delivery across architects, developers, functional consultants, testers, integration teams, and customer SMEs

• Monitor requirements gathering and setting acceptance criteria, ensure backlog items are sized, prioritized, and ready for build

• Drive testing readiness, including test planning, data availability, environment coordination, defect management, and go-live preparation

• Maintain strong RAID discipline, proactively identifying risks, issues, dependencies, and downstream impacts

• Identify scope gaps early and initiate structured change-control discussions when required

• Run governance forums that drive real decisions, including steering committees, risk reviews, and change control boards

• Communicate clear, factual status and risk updates to customers, senior project managers, and program leadership

• Partner with customers to strengthen their ability to participate effectively in requirements, testing, data readiness, and decision-making

• Contribute to continuous improvement of HSO’s Standard Working Practices (SWP) and delivery quality culture

• Depending on seniority and complexity of an assigned project, you will work under the guidance and direction of a Senior Project Manager or Program Manager.

**Requirements

**

• 3–5+ year’s experience delivering ERP. Data, or digital transformation projects experience is preferable into ERP Implementation experience

• Must exposure to Dynamics 365 ERP experience or comparable enterprise platforms

• Experience in complex, multi-team or multi-stakeholder environments

• Strong grounding in planning, backlog management, requirements clarification, testing preparation, and RAID (Risks, Actions, Issues, and Decisions)

• Experience working within structured delivery frameworks and governance models

• Ability to see and manage task-level delays and manage their downstream impacts

• Ability to simplify complexity and drive clarity in pressured environments

• Experience using DevOps or similar delivery management tools.

• Hands-on, structured, and proactive approach to execution and problem solving.

• Confidence to escalate issues factually and early

• Influence without authority; create clarity and accountability through facts, options, and trade-offs

• Structured approach to risk management, ambiguity, and scenario-based decision-making

• Awareness of delivery economics and commercial impact

• Ability to balance scope, quality, time, and cost without false certainty

• International travel required depending on program needs. Minimun 35% travelling

**Benefits

****Why should you choose HSO International?

****_Development and growth

_**You get a job with plenty of career opportunities with a leading provider of innovative enterprise business solutions and a distinct Microsoft Global Solution Integrator, who perceives your motivations, talents, and ambitions.

**Career Path for this role

****HSO Offers a Clear, Capability-based Progression For Delivery Professionals

**Project Coordinator / PMO → Project Manager → Senior Project Manager → Program Manager.

Project Managers grow by mastering execution discipline, customer leadership, and cross-team coordination within global transformation programs.

**_Fun and success

_**You work in a collaborative and professional environment where success is built on teamwork and with colleagues who are ready to help each other.

**_International project exposure

_**Joining our team offers an exciting opportunity to engage in international projects, providing invaluable exposure to diverse cultures, markets, and perspectives. Through your involvement in these projects, you will broaden your global network, enhance your cross-cultural communication skills, and gain firsthand experience in navigating the complexities of international collaboration.

**_Freedom and responsibility

_**You have the freedom and flexibility to organize your workdays, but especially to shape your own career.

**Take the next step!

**Does the combination of business processes and Microsoft technology appeal to you? Take the next step in your career path with HSO International!

**Job Description Summary

**Activities contributing to the design, development, and lifecycle support of products, solutions, and systems. Includes activities linked to new product development and technical improvement of existing products and components. The role impacts approaches, projects, and programs within the functional area and supports both R&D and manufacturing activities. Impacts quality, efficiency, and effectiveness of the team. Has significant input into technical priorities and engineering decisions. Guided by professional practices and policies while requiring a high level of operational judgment.

**Job Description

****Roles and Responsibilities

**

• Responsible for electronic hardware design and engineering, including designing, developing, modifying, and evaluating electronic circuits, assemblies, and subsystems for medical devices and other hardware systems. Common skill sets include Power Electronics, Analog, Digital, Mixed Signal, Power Management, Battery Systems, DC/DC Converters, Microcontrollers, and Embedded Hardware.

• Develop specialized knowledge within the power electronics discipline and serve as a technical resource within the team. Maintain awareness of the latest technical developments and contribute to engineering strategy, best practices, and technology decisions.

• Apply technical expertise to design robust, reliable, and manufacturable electronic solutions. Perform circuit analysis, hardware debugging, verification testing, root cause investigations, and evaluation of design alternatives.

• Support products throughout their lifecycle, including manufacturing support, production issue resolution, component obsolescence management, design improvements, and implementation of engineering changes.

• Use judgment to solve moderately complex technical problems across product development, manufacturing, quality, and supplier interactions. Take a practical and data-driven approach to identifying root causes and implementing corrective actions.

• Participate in Engineering Change Request (ECR) and Engineering Change Order (ECO) activities, including impact assessments, technical documentation, verification planning, and implementation of design changes.

• Act as a resource for colleagues with less experience. May lead small projects with moderate risks and resource requirements. Explains difficult or sensitive information and works across functions to build consensus and drive technical solutions.

**Required Qualifications

**

• Experience in Engineering/Technology and Electronic Hardware knowledge level is comparable to a Master's degree from an university or college (or equivalent relevant experience).

• Strong background in electronic hardware development with demonstrated experience in power electronics.

• Working knowledge of analog and digital electronics and the integration of complete electronic systems.

• Experience with laboratory testing, troubleshooting, debugging, and verification of electronic hardware.

• Experience supporting manufacturing activities, including root cause analysis, corrective actions, and implementation of hardware improvements.

**Desired Characteristics

**

• Strong experience with power electronics, power supplies, power management, battery-powered products, or related disciplines.

• Experience supporting products in production environments and working with manufacturing, quality, sourcing, and suppliers to resolve technical issues.

• Familiarity with ECR/ECO processes, design transfer, production launch, and lifecycle management activities.

• Strong oral and written communication skills. Strong interpersonal and leadership skills. Demonstrated ability to analyze and resolve problems. Established project management and cross-functional collaboration skills.

******Additional Information

******Relocation Assistance Provided: No

jobs.occupation: Senior Hardware Productization Engineer / Mechatronics Lead
jobs.description:
The role

We are looking for a senior hardware/product development engineer with strong experience taking physical products from prototype through engineering validation and into manufacturing.

You will work directly with the founder and take ownership of the physical architecture of Dreamspire.

This is not primarily a firmware role and it is not a pure industrial-design role.

We need someone who can look at a prototype and systematically turn it into a product.

You should be comfortable moving between:

• mechanical engineering

• electronics integration

• manufacturing

• prototyping

• reliability

• assembly

• suppliers

• cost

• compliance

• user experience

A large part of the work will initially be hands-on.

Your first mission

Your first objective will be to create a clear Dreamspire Product Architecture V1.

You will examine the existing prototype, identify its weaknesses and determine how we should build the next generation of the system.

This includes answering questions such as:

• Which prototype mechanisms are suitable for a real product?

• What needs to be redesigned?

• Which components should be custom versus off-the-shelf?

• How should cameras, lighting, electronics and mechanical systems be integrated?

• How do we make assembly simple and repeatable?

• What are the major reliability risks?

• What manufacturing processes should we use?

• What should the production BOM look like?

• What needs tooling?

• What can initially be produced in low volume?

• What compliance and certification work will be required?

• How do we move from one prototype to 10, 100 and eventually thousands of units?

The objective is not to rush into manufacturing.

The objective is to progressively remove technical and manufacturing risk until the product is ready.

Responsibilities

You will:

• Audit the existing Dreamspire hardware and mechanical architecture.

• Design and build improved prototype generations.

• Own mechanical design and product engineering.

• Integrate cameras, PCBs, lighting, power, cabling, connectors and sensors into the physical product.

• Design enclosures, mounts, mechanisms and structural components.

• Define tolerances and mechanical interfaces.

• Design for manufacturing and assembly — DFM/DFA.

• Reduce part count, assembly complexity and manufacturing cost.

• Select appropriate materials and production methods.

• Decide when to use CNC, sheet metal, 3D printing, injection molding or other processes.

• Work with PCB/electronics engineers where specialist electrical work is required.

• Develop production BOMs and cost estimates.

• Source and evaluate components and suppliers.

• Communicate directly with prototype houses and manufacturers.

• Design test fixtures and production test procedures.

• Establish reliability and lifecycle testing.

• Help define EVT, DVT and PVT stages.

• Identify CE, EMC, electrical safety and other relevant compliance requirements.

• Help design the system for serviceability and repair.

• Help prepare Dreamspire for small pilot production and eventually mass production.

What we are looking for

The most important requirement is:

You have personally helped ship real physical products.

Ideally, you have taken products through several stages of:

prototype → engineering validation → manufacturing → production → customer

You should have strong practical experience with several of the following:

• Mechanical engineering

• Mechatronics

• Consumer electronics

• Product development

• DFM / DFA

• CAD

• Injection-molded plastic parts

• CNC and rapid prototyping

• Electronics packaging

• PCB integration

• Cameras / optical systems

• Sensors

• Motors or electromechanical systems

• Tolerance analysis

• Supplier management

• BOM optimization

• Production testing

• Reliability testing

• Manufacturing ramp-up

You should be comfortable physically building, modifying and debugging prototypes rather than only designing them.

Particularly relevant backgrounds

Experience from products such as these would be especially relevant:

• Consumer electronics

• Robotics

• Smart-home products

• Interactive toys

• Gaming hardware

• IoT products

• Camera systems

• Medical or laboratory devices

• Small electromechanical products

Experience working in a startup or small product-development team is a major advantage.

What we are not looking for

This is probably not the right role if your experience is primarily:

• Arduino hobby projects

• Pure firmware development

• PCB design without product/mechanical ownership

• Industrial design without engineering responsibility

• CAD work without manufacturing experience

• Large-company engineering where manufacturing and suppliers were handled entirely by other teams

We are looking for someone who understands the whole physical product.

How you work

You should enjoy environments where the product is still evolving.

You should be able to say:

“This prototype mechanism works, but it will not survive production.”

or:

“We can remove these five components if we redesign this assembly.”

or:

“Don’t spend money tooling this yet — we need to validate this part first.”

We want someone who challenges assumptions and prevents expensive mistakes rather than simply implementing specifications.

Working with the founder

You will work closely with the founder, who currently develops the software, computer-vision systems, embedded systems and game concepts.

You will therefore have considerable influence over the architecture of the product.

The expectation is that you become the technical owner of the physical Dreamspire platform, while working closely with software and game development.

If the collaboration works well, the role could evolve into something resembling:

Head of Hardware / Head of Product Engineering

as Dreamspire grows.

Location

The role is based around Copenhagen.

Much of the work can be done remotely, but during prototype development we expect regular hands-on work with the physical Dreamspire system.

Candidates elsewhere in Denmark or the Øresund region are welcome if they can work regularly in Copenhagen.

Relocation support is not available at this stage.

Employment

We are open to:

• Full-time employment

• 3–4 days/week

• An initial senior consulting/fractional arrangement that can develop into a permanent role

For a strong permanent candidate, expected salary is approximately:

65,000–75,000 DKK/month + pension, depending on experience.

Exceptional candidates with significant consumer-product leadership experience may be above this range.

Why this role is interesting

Dreamspire is not another incremental electronics product.

The aim is to create an entirely new category of tabletop gaming platform and then build multiple games on top of it.

The fundamental question is:

Can we create something with the physical presence and social experience of a board game, but with systems and mechanics that were previously only practical in video games?

A large part of whether that succeeds depends on making the hardware disappear into the experience.

That is the problem we want you to help solve.

How to apply

Email jobs@dreamspire.dk with your CV and a few lines about the physical products you have helped ship. We read every application and use it only to assess it; see how we handle your data.

Celare Quantum Communications is a Danish high-tech quantum technology company with a mission to radically improve cybersecurity and enable trusted global data sharing.

Our core product is a unique, cutting-edge technology born from years of university research called Continuous-Variable Quantum Key Distribution (CV-QKD). This technology enables post-quantum secure key exchange for protecting sensitive data across critical infrastructure.

Celare partners with local and international governments, telecom operators, data centers, banks, defense ministries, and leading academic institutions. Over the past year our team has successfully launched commercial pilot deployments of our technology.

The Celare Team

We are a highly specialized and ambitious team of quantum engineers, serial entrepreneurs, laser, RF and electronics specialists, mathematicians, software engineers, and IC and FPGA designers.

Based in Copenhagen, we combine deep academic expertise with hands-on experience in launching complex, high-impact technology products.

The Role

In this role you will get a unique opportunity to work at the cutting edge of quantum technology development. You will be part of a small team of optical engineers responsible for optical development and test activities in the company. You will have a key role in our Photonic Integrated Circuit (PIC) development activities as a technical point of contact with our development partners.

As part of a small and agile organization, you will contribute across the full product lifecycle — from early architectural decisions and prototyping to production and large-scale deployment. You will work both in collaboration with our team and independently as a specialist, sharing knowledge across disciplines.

This is a hands-on role with real responsibility and influence. It offers work with an international, multilingual and multicultural dynamic team with direct connection to academic research and bleeding-edge technologies.

The role is situated on site in our Copenhagen headquarters.

Responsibilities

• Leading and carrying out various PIC development activities

• Planning and execution of PIC test activities

• Development of optical subsystems for our CV-QKD and Quantum Random Number Generator (QRNG) products

• Maintaining and extending the company’s optical laboratories

• Contributing specialist knowledge and collaborating to make the team excel at product development

Qualifications

• MSc or PhD in optics or similar

• 5+ years of work experience

• Experience with conducting experiments in fiber and/or free-space optics

• Experience with PIC technology and development

• Hands-on experience working with digital/analog electronics

• (Optional) Experience in using quantum theory

We Offer

This full-time position offers the opportunity to build and shape the future of quantum communication in collaboration with an experienced and dynamic team. We provide individual growth plans aligned with your personal preferences and motivation. We offer competitive compensation, depending on qualifications.

Contact

For more information or if you wish to apply, send an email to jobs@celare-quantum.com and mark the subject line: “Optical Engineer”.
